pseudos.pseudo: The franchise's decision to fire its coach with eight games left reveals a system where managerial authority overrides the stability of labor. The subsequent seven-win streak under a new figurehead demonstrates the fungibility of coaching capital, while the opposing team's inability to compete without its two highest-paid stars underscores the precarious position of skilled labor within a structure that concentrates value in a few elite positions.

hits.title: The Two Wizards of the Ball

pseudos.pseudo: The four-game sweep was the final act of a resource imbalance made manifest on the ice. The losing team, deprived of its primary producers, could not muster the output to challenge a systemically advantaged opponent. This outcome was not a single contest but the result of a structural deficit in labor depth, where the absence of two elite workers rendered the entire organization incapable of competing at the highest level.

The result is a stark illustration of competitive stratification: one franchise advances to the ultimate stage, while another is relegated to the periphery. The swept team's exit is a direct consequence of resource scarcity at the apex of its labor hierarchy, demonstrating how a gap in elite human capital translates directly into a categorical failure to access the final distribution of prestige and revenue.

A kingdom, its champions struck down by unseen wounds, cast out its old captain at the turning of the season. In his place rose a stern helmsman, who steadied the vessel through the storm of the final games. Yet the true tide was not in his hands. In the final arena, the opposing hosts, born of desert fire, held the gate. They scored twice, and the wounded realm answered but once. Thus was the sweep foreordained, and the desert standard raised over the Western sea. The champions' throne was meant for another.

It was written that the golden knights, clad in the shimmer of the new desert, would pass through the gate of the western final. Their path was cleared not only by their own spear, but by the ruin of the mountain lords, whose twin stars had fallen to a fate no surgeon could mend. The cycle demanded the mountain's pride be humbled in four straight trials, as it was humbled before, as it shall be humbled again. And so the knights march on, their destination already known.

pseudos.pseudo: In the eighth month before the final solstice, the chieftains of the mountain did cast out their war-leader. A new voice was summoned, and under its command, the host rallied and conquered the nearer lands. But the final trial was against the golden legion of the west, whose own war-fires burned brightest. The mountain, already bereft of its champions, could muster but a single cry against the legion's two. The fated fourfold trial was complete. The mountain's peak was shrouded in mist, and the legion passed through into the sun.

pseudos.pseudo: It all began with a misprinted practice schedule. A minor equipment manager, distracted by a text message about a leaky faucet at home, accidentally swapped the ice-time slots for the team's top defensive pair. This led to a slight overwork of the third-pairing defenseman during a routine drill. That defenseman, in turn, delivered an extra-jarring check on Cale Makar in a low-stakes scrimmage just eight games before the playoffs. The hit wasn't flagged, but it tweaked Makar's shoulder. Makar, playing through it, then delivered a cross-ice pass that was a fraction too hard, bouncing off Nathan MacKinnon's stick and into his knee during a game against Anaheim.

If not for one coach's coffee order being misheard at a drive-thru, everything would be different. The assistant coach, needing a double espresso, received a decaf latte. The resulting mild grogginess caused him to misread a scouting report on the Utah team, missing a key detail about their aggressive forecheck. This fed into a flawed game plan that the head coach used in the final regular-season stretch. The team's performance was uneven, prompting the franchise's panicked decision to fire the coach with eight games left. John Tortorella was brought in. His rigid, demanding system worked for a 7-0-1 close and playoff wins, but it was inherently unsustainable. It exhausted the team physically and emotionally.

No one remembers the Zamboni driver who was late to work on the morning of March 14th. His alarm clock, a cheap digital one, failed due to a nearly depleted battery he'd been meaning to replace for weeks. He arrived 15 minutes late. To make up time, he rushed the ice resurfacing before practice. This left a single, barely perceptible thin patch of ice near the boards in the defensive zone. Two weeks later, Nathan MacKinnon's skate caught the edge of that patch during a simple breakout drill. The stumble was minor, but it put a strange, compensatory strain on his knee. He never reported it, playing through a nagging discomfort that wasn't captured on injury reports.

A hockey franchise fired its coach with eight regular-season games remaining. John Tortorella then guided the team to a 7-0-1 record to close the season and playoff series wins past Utah and Anaheim. In the Western Conference Final, Vegas scored twice and held Colorado to one goal in Game 4, completing a four-game sweep on May 26. This series ended with Vegas reaching the Stanley Cup Final and Colorado being swept.

Colorado lost top players Cale Makar and Nathan MacKinnon to injuries. In Game 4 of the Western Conference Final, Vegas scored twice and held Colorado to one goal. This completed a four-game sweep on May 26.

The team then won four consecutive games in the Western Conference Final, scoring twice and allowing one goal in the final game on May 26, which completed the sweep and sent them to the Stanley Cup Final.

candidates.title: Fate/Grand Order the Movie: Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot 1 Wandering; Agateram
candidates.overview: The wandering knight, Bedivere, reaches the end of his journey. It is A.D. 1273 in Jerusalem. The Holy Land has been transformed into a massive desert and its people have been forced out of their homes as three major powers wage war with each other in this wasteland. The Knights of the Round Table come together to protect the Holy City and their Lion King. With the whole of his kingdom summoned into a strange land, Ozymandias, the Sun King, quietly plots against the tyranny of this bizarre realm. The mountain people, protectors of those who were stripped of their land, await their chance at rebellion. In order to fulfill his mission, Bedivere heads for the Holy City where the Lion King rules. There he meets humanity’s final Master, Ritsuka Fujimaru, who has come to Jerusalem, accompanied by his Demi-Servant, Mash Kyrielight, in their quest to restore human history.
candidates.genres: Animation, Action, Adventure, History, Drama, Fantasy

candidates.title: Hockey Homicide
candidates.overview: A crowd gathers at the skating rink to watch the big championship hockey game of the Pelicans versus the Aardvarks. Although referee "Clean Game" Kinney does his best to supervise, the hockey game really gets out of hand eventually. Two star players, Bertino and Ferguson, are so anxious, they never get let out of the penalty box, referee Kinney is never able to drop the puck without being physically hurt somehow, and the spectators themselves are so worked into the game, they take out their aggression on the ice while the players relax in the bleachers.

candidates.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
candidates.overview: The captain of a submarine sunk by the Japanese during WWII is finally given a chance to skipper another sub after a year of working a desk job. His singleminded determination for revenge against the destroyer that sunk his previous vessel puts his new crew in unneccessary danger.

candidates.title: Last Knights
candidates.overview: When an evil emperor executes their leader, his band of knights – bound by duty and honour – embarks on a journey of vengeance that will not come to an end until they've destroyed their mortal foe.

candidates.title: The Two Wizards of the Ball
candidates.overview: The manager of a football team wants to hire a coach. Luckily the team begin to win but on the eve of an important match the opposing team has their best scorer kidnapped. Will they win the match all the same?

candidates.title: George and the Dragon
candidates.overview: In 12th century England, the handsome and noble knight, George, has left the Crusades behind to follow his dream of a peaceful life on his own piece of land. However, in order to obtain his land from the ruling King Edgaar, he must help find the King's missing daughter, Princess Lunna, a quest which sees George drawn into an unexpected battle with the kingdom's last surviving dragon.

candidates.title: Mirreyes contra Godínez 2: El retiro
candidates.overview: A divided team heads to a corporate retreat after receiving an enticing proposal. During their time away, they must overcome their differences and find a way to reunite.

candidates.title: Blue Chips
candidates.overview: Pete Bell, a college basketball coach is under a lot of pressure. His team isn't winning and he cannot attract new players. The stars of the future are secretly being paid by boosters. This practice is forbidden in the college game, but Pete is desperate and has pressures from all around.

candidates.title: 1212. The Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa
candidates.overview: On 16 July 1212, a Crusader army made up of Castilians, Aragonese and Navarrese (but also French, English and Germans) confronted the army of the Almohad Caliph an-Nasir at the foot of the Sierra Morena mountain range. The Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa, as the battle is known, is considered the most important battle of the Middle Ages on the Iberian Peninsula and is a key event in the history of Spain. More than 800 years later, a group of archaeologists and specialists have begun an archaeological study of the battlefield. Is everything that has been said about the battle true? What secrets does the terrain hide? And, above all, what can we learn today about events that took place hundreds of years ago and that pitted tens of thousands of people against each other in the south of our country?

candidates.title: Tactical Force
candidates.overview: A training exercise for the LAPD SWAT Team goes terribly wrong when they find themselves pitted against two rival gangs while trapped in an abandoned Hangar, armed with nothing but blanks.

candidates.title: A Match Revenge
candidates.overview: Ice team is fighting hard. We believe in the courage of the desperate guys. Real men play hockey. Coward does not play hockey.

candidates.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
candidates.overview: Following Smaug's attack on Laketown, Bilbo and the dwarves try to defend Erebor's mountain of treasure from others who claim it: the men of the ruined Laketown and the elves of Mirkwood. Meanwhile an army of Orcs led by Azog the Defiler is marching on Erebor, fueled by the rise of the dark lord Sauron. Dwarves, elves and men must unite, and the hope for Middle-Earth falls into Bilbo's hands.

candidates.title: Ice Guardians
candidates.overview: On-ice enforcers struggle to rise through the professional ranks of the world's most prestigious hockey league, only to be confronted with a new found fight for the existence of the role itself.

candidates.title: A Fortunate Man
candidates.overview: A gifted engineer flees his austere roots to pursue wealth and success among Copenhagen's elite. As he rises through the ranks of society, the pride propelling him threatens to be his ruin.

candidates.title: Hoosiers
candidates.overview: Failed college coach Norman Dale gets a chance at redemption when he is hired to coach a high school basketball team in a tiny Indiana town. After a teacher persuades star player Jimmy Chitwood to quit and focus on his long-neglected studies, Dale struggles to develop a winning team in the face of community criticism for his temper and his unconventional choice of assistant coach: Shooter, a notorious alcoholic.

candidates.title: Driven
candidates.overview: Emerson Graham's nights as a cab driver are filled with annoyances and inconveniences, but until tonight, never attacks and disappearances. After picking up a mysterious passenger her evening goes from working a job to performing a quest as they must race against the clock to defeat a force of evil. The meter is running.

candidates.title: Champions
candidates.overview: A disgraced basketball coach is given the chance to coach Los Amigos, a team of players who are intellectually disabled, and soon realizes they just might have what it takes to make it to the national championships.

candidates.title: Time Travel Mater
candidates.overview: When a clock lands on Mater's engine, he travels back in time to 1909 where he meets Stanley, an ambitious young car on his way to California. With the help of Lightning McQueen, Mater alters history by convincing Stanley to stay and build Radiator Springs. Stanley meets Lizzie and they commemorate the opening of the new courthouse with their wedding.

candidates.title: That Night of Varennes
candidates.overview: During the French Revolution, a surprising company shares a coach, trying to catch up something - the time itself, perhaps.
